verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents an official MCP server that gives AI models a standardized interface to its scraping, structured extraction and crawling capabilities. The server lives in the first-party hyperbrowserai/mcp GitHub repo, which lists concrete tools such as scrape_webpage, and a probe confirmed the docs page. missing for 10: documented client connection and setup steps in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Hyperbrowser MCP server provides a standardized interface for AI models to access powerful web automation capabilities like scraping, structured extraction, and crawling.
`scrape_webpage` - Extract formatted (markdown, screenshot etc) content from any webpage
